title: Yedoo AI — Reading Workspace for PDF & EPUB Books
excerpt: Read, listen, discuss, and create from your books with an AI-powered reading workspace.
content_html:
Yedoo AI · A place for your books

More time
with a good book.

Read PDF, EPUB, PPT, TXT, MOBI, and more. Mark a passage, ask a question, pick up where you left off.

Take a look

At the page

Room to read.
And think.

On attentionProduct preview

A sample page

The art of noticing

Some pages ask us to slow down. A sentence catches our attention, and we read it once more.

Reading leaves room for a thought of our own.

We mark the passage, leave a note, and turn the page. There is no need to hurry.
